{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|When I get my own starship, I'll get my sector permit.|Greedo|<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
A '''Sector Permit''' was a type of permit issued by a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] or [[Oversector/Legends|oversector]] government that granted the bearer permission to work as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] within their jurisdiction. The exact legal restrictions governing the operation of Sector Permits varied from region to region and while in some localities a Sector Permit by itself was all that was required in order to legally pursue [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]], in most areas a corresponding [[Target Permit]] was also required to be held by the bearer. Sector Permits cost between 1,000 and 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a [[Standard month/Legends|month]], with the cost set by the sector government that issued the permit.
